title: Hearty French New Potatoes Coq Au Vin
description: A macrobiotic friendly French dish featuring new potatoes and chicken in a rich malty sauce, served in a corn husk wrap, inspired by the traditional Coq Au Vin and Korean ssam wrap
instructions: In a large Dutch oven, cook the chicken and onions in a little bit of oil over medium heat until browned.
Add the carrots, malt vinegar, red wine, and tomato paste to the pot, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the mixture for 25 minutes, then add the halved new potatoes to the pot.
Continue to braise for an additional 20 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
While the Coq Au Vin is cooking, prepare the corn husks by soaking them in water for 30 minutes.
To assemble the dish, place a portion of the Coq Au Vin onto a corn husk, then top with a sprig of fresh thyme.
Serve the Coq Au Vin in the corn husk wrap, allowing each guest to assemble their own ssam wrap.
